displayDescription: Style-022 Pencil Drawing: a hatched graphite idea sphere draws itself on cool bristol paper, then pencil connectors grow into a five-node system.
styleRenderer: Canvas 2D (style-022 Pencil Drawing: paper substrate, graphite tooth mask, pressure-tapered strokes, stump smudge sprites)
Rough.js 4.6.6 (seeded contours, connector lines, hachure cast shadow; local rough.js bundle)
motionEngine: GSAP 3 paused timeline at window.__timelines.video (sole owner of draw-progress state and note clip-path/opacity; Canvas redraws from timeline state on update and hf-seek)
limitations: Graphite and paper are procedural approximations (seeded grain, tooth alpha mask, pressure taper, low-res smudge). There is no physical media simulation.
Rough.js hachure and custom seeded hatching are vector line approximations of pencil hatching.
Notes are set in system Georgia italic, not real handwriting. A serif fallback is used where Georgia is missing.
Silent: no soundtrack or voice was requested for this preview.
